reviewedPackages.review: The complete published LICENSE has Flutter's BSD-3-Clause notice followed by aFileChooser's Apache-2.0 notice (Paul Burke). Both components are already allowed; this is not a blanket approval of GitHub's non-SPDX identifier. The downloaded archive matched pubspec.lock and its LICENSE matched the installed package. Flutter retains these notices in its generated license bundle. Re-review any version, source, manifest, or identifier change.
